received_works.body:
Hello there! I really like your art style so I would like to commission a picture from you of Lowen in this yakuza like outfit from a past commission: https://postimg.cc/9Dq06NZZ

I would like for Lowen to have an annoyed frown on his face while he is sitting in the pose linked below. I want the atmosphere of the image to be very serious and ominous like a true yakuza boss! And if possible, may I have a transparent variant? It's okay if that isn't possible! Thank you for your consideration! ^^

Pose: https://postimg.cc/ZBvT1W1H
More Lowen references: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1cKxGfhORCqpp__mreoRUBaAX4hBox7uQ?usp=sharing

こんにちは！
あなたの作品はとても素敵です。
『ハリー・ポッター』のカップリング、ルシウス・マルフォイとハーマイオニー・グレンジャーのファンアートを委託したいです。（J.K.ローリングは二次創作を認めています）

ルシウス・マルフォイ
身長: 183cm
髪の色: プラチナブロンド (薄金色)
瞳の色: グレー
性格: 狡猾で傲慢、そして偏屈な性格。洗練された裕福な純血の魔法使いとして振る舞うが、その本性は残忍で二枚舌、権力欲に駆られたものであることが露呈する。

ハーマイオニー・グレンジャー
身長: 165cm
髪の色: ボサボサの茶髪（豊かでモジャモジャ）
瞳の色: 茶色
性格: 類まれな知性、揺るぎない忠誠心、そして強い正義感

関係性:
ストックホルム症候群、愛憎関係

キャラ設定はURLを参照してください
雰囲気や構図等はお任せ致します
服装等、細かいデザインは描きやすいように一部変更して頂いても大丈夫です
PSDに線画や練習絵、没ラフ等があれば入れてくれると嬉しいです。宜しくお願い致します。
もし金額が足りないのであれば、適当な金額でのアピールをお願いします。

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1TZ1kQIzMLNaUUMgGq1M26splwqIR0maM?usp=sharing

Hello I really love you art!

I was wondering if you could please make a art working using my vtuber in a pose similar to the a Zoro pose provided. In the art I would remove Zoro's normal swords and replaced with my gun blade, I would like to keep the chest scar Zoro has and add in the arm scars as well on the left arm. The pose with the gunblade does not have to be exact I will leave that up to you whether you want to move around the arms for freedom of you art and how you would like to design it. Below will be the art refrences.

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1qm_N26G63K-mXxjy24smTx_42S8sibE3/view?usp=drive_link

Hi! i'm a huge fan of your work and the ones on twitter, really pretty! 
I'd like an full body art of my friend, he is a big big fan of one piece and so i'd to draw him as a character from it. 
I've shared 2 pictures of him in the link. 

The pose, clothes and expression is up to you, but the whole vibe of the art is to be prideful, strength, cool aspect, he adores Boa hancock and love Katanas if this helps you in any way xD

Can i have this to be 16:9? I'd like your permission to have this as his profile picture on twitter as well
 if possible don't make him bare chested (have to be wearing clothes) please make sure there's no cross as we're muslims!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1imDw3fBHTK5rika54jvXFuuaCNtIhBd1?usp=sharing

Hello! Nice to meet you!
I really love your artwork and would like to request art of my vampire character. He’s an outgoing, clever and reckless guy who sometimes gets himself into trouble because of his reckless nature. He's good at fighting his way out of it though. He enjoys skateboarding and likes to hang out at the local skate park.
He hasn't been a vampire for long and is trying to get used to this new lifestyle even if it isn't always easy. 
His hair is brown, his eyes are green and he’s 186 cm tall. He has a lean but athletic build. 
I will leave pose, expression and composition to you. You can also change his clothing if you like, anything modern and trendy works very well for him. 
You are also free to draw him with his cat if you like: https://i.ibb.co/31BZTJz/Mercury-Ref.png.

Thank you so much!

https://i.ibb.co/PCCJ1g6/Benjamin-Ref.png

Nice to meet you! I like your art!

Could you please draw an illustration of these characters? They are from a modern Call of Cthulhu (CoC) TRPG setting. They have a hero and villain dynamic.

Alois
180 cm. Blond male. Very skinny.
He has a talkative, mischievous, and sly personality. His usual expression is a big grin.
He is a member of an organization that fights supernatural threats.
Despite the fact that Gabe is a villain, Alois is obsessed with him.

Gabe
186 cm. Grey haired male. Muscular.
His usual expression is a smile. He has an irreverent and casual personality, but he is also secretly very dangerous.
He is the villain of the story.

Could you please draw an illustration where they are sparring with each other?
Gabe is training Alois to fight. Gabe is confident and casual. Alois is determined to show off and look cool to Gabe so he is trying his best. However, Gabe can easily defeat Alois in a fight.

Either way, thank you so much for reading this request!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1atjIzPqghGCslfuaHI8uE5rk5gzVuPSz
